name: Find Lowest Price Flights from California to France
description: Comprehensive guide to search and find the best flight deals from California to France using Google Flights
instructions: Open Chrome browser
Click the plus (+) icon at the top of the browser window next to the rightmost tab to open a new tab
Click on the address bar
Type google.com/travel/flights and press Enter
Verify you're on the Google Flights page with the 'Flights' heading displayed
Under the search form, ensure Round trip and Economy options are selected
Click on the departure field (it may show a city name already like 'Port Harcourt')
If there's text already in the field, click on it and delete the existing text
Type 'California' and wait for the dropdown suggestions
Select 'Los Angeles, California, USA' from the dropdown options
Click on the destination field (labeled 'Where to?')
Type 'France' and wait for dropdown suggestions
Select 'Paris, France' or another preferred city in France
Click on the Departure date field
Select your preferred departure date from the calendar
Click on the Return date field
Select your preferred return date (typically 7-14 days after departure)
Click the blue 'Explore' button to search for flights
Wait for the search results to load
Use the filters at the top of the results to refine your search (Stops, Price, Airlines, etc.)
Sort results by price (lowest first) if not already sorted
Review the flight options displayed
Click on a flight to see more details
Check baggage allowance and layover information
To track prices, click the 'Track prices' button (sign in with Google account if prompted)
To proceed with booking, click on your chosen flight option
